title: Invariant vectors span for a locally constant matrix Galois cocycle
statement: Let K be a field, S its separable closure, n any natural number, and b : Gal(S/K) → GL_n(S) locally constant satisfying b(g) g(b(h)) = b(gh). The S-linear span in S^n of the vectors v satisfying b(g) g(v) = v for every g is all of S^n.

proof.text: Use the proved open-normal right-stabilizer theorem and the normal Krull neighbourhood basis to choose a finite Galois intermediate field L through whose restriction map q the values of b factor. Choose lifts s of automorphisms of L. No descent of b entries is required.

Define the additive semilinear operators T_g(v)=b(g)g(v). Verify composition from the cocycle law and T_1=id. On each standard vector e_i, T_g(e_i) depends only on q(g). Weighted sums A(a,i)=sum_sigma sigma(a) T_(s sigma)(e_i), for a in L, are invariant by semilinearity and left-multiplication reindexing.

If e_i is outside the S-span W of invariant vectors, Mathlib Submodule.exists_le_ker_of_notMem supplies a functional vanishing on W but not on e_i. Its values on all A(a,i) give a relation among distinct embeddings L into S. Mathlib linearIndependent_monoidHom makes every coefficient zero; the identity coefficient is f(e_i), a contradiction. Expand every vector as a sum of scalar multiples of standard vectors to conclude W=top.

lean.statement:
theorem galois_invariant_vectors_span (K : Type u) [Field K] (n : ℕ)
    (b : Gal(SeparableClosure K/K) →
      Matrix.GeneralLinearGroup (Fin n) (SeparableClosure K))
    (hb : IsLocallyConstant b)
    (hcoc : ∀ g h, b g * Matrix.GeneralLinearGroup.map g.toRingHom (b h) = b (g * h)) :
    Submodule.span (SeparableClosure K)
      {v : Fin n → SeparableClosure K | ∀ g, (b g).val.mulVec (g ∘ v) = v} = ⊤
